status: candidate five-region partition pending author map approval
purpose: Outcome-blind region definition and leave-one-catchment input-support screen

partition_rule.catchments: eligible support-cell center locates in the corresponding regional Firedrake mesh
partition_rule.overlap_policy: assign narrow mesh-overlap cells to the containing mesh with greatest distance from its exterior boundary
partition_rule.intercatchment: eligible cells outside all three catchment meshes
partition_rule.intercatchment_separator: PIG-Thwaites when y >= -400000 m; Thwaites-Dotson otherwise

support_method.marginal: per-feature test fraction inside training q01-q99
support_method.joint_transform: whole-sector rank-Gaussian then whitened PCA retaining >=99% variance
